text:
Nadia P: Dropping the final launch blog intro, short email, and two press teasers. Need legal quick-pass + confirm HubSpot routing and hidden fields. Target publish Fri 9am PT.

Nadia P: EMAIL SUBJECT SUGGESTION:
```
Redwood Inference is here  Predictable, production LLM inference (webinar + try)
```
EMAIL HERO (one line): Built for engineers: predictable latency, more consistent unit cost, and deploy-anywhere options.
CTAs:
- Try the API -> https://redwood.com/signup?utm_source=email&utm_campaign=launch_sep2026&utm_medium=email
- Register webinar -> https://redwood.com/webinar?utm_source=email&utm_campaign=launch_sep2026&utm_medium=email
Hidden field suggestion: campaign_launch=sep2026_launch

Evan L: Love it. Can we avoid exact percent claims in the hero? Product requests "more consistent unit cost" is fine. Add bench link in blog: https://redwood.com/bench/sep-launch-methods.

Marco T: Ops: HubSpot form created: "Launch - Trial Sep2026". Workflow: "Launch Trial Routing Sep2026" -> Queue: launch-sep26-sdr. Webhook for registrants -> https://hooks.redwood.com/webinar/sep is live. Hidden field configured as requested.

Sofia R: PRESS TEASER (short, ~95w):
```
Redwood Inference launches a production-grade inference platform combining intelligent batching, KV caching, and unified routing to give engineering teams more consistent performance and clearer economics. Supports hosted, dedicated, and private deployments, with rollout controls and per-route observability. Attend our launch webinar for benchmarks and real-world examples.
```

Sofia R: PRESS SNIPPET (wire ~165w):
```
Redwood Inference today announces a developer-first platform for running large language model inference with production-grade latency controls and cost observability. The platform pairs a GPU-optimized runtime with smart routing, workload-aware caching, and model lifecycle tooling to reduce variability and simplify rollouts across hosted, dedicated, and private environments. Engineers gain per-route tracing, canary rollouts, and cost controls that make inference predictable at scale. Redwood will host a launch webinar to walk through benchmarks and deployment patterns. More: https://redwood.com/press
```

legal: Quick-pass complete. Approve copy with one condition: any numeric performance claims must live in the benchmark section with a methodology link. Avoid standalone absolute savings language in hero or email.

press-bot: Automated check: short teaser length OK (~93 words). Recommend a 50-word embargoed headline for top-tier outlets if needed.

Nadia P: Thanks all. Final checklist Ill lock: meta image (1200x630), hero quote, CTAs + UTMs, bench & methods links, HubSpot form + hidden field, webhook, press CSV, social snippets. Marco/Tara can you confirm meta image and social copy by EOD?

Marco T: Meta image ready, social snippets scheduled.

ops-bot: HubSpot & webhook validation complete. Workflow routes to queue: launch-sep26-sdr.

Nadia P: Locking publish: Fri 9am PT. Ill upload final assets here and ping channel once live. Thanks! :rocket:
